verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at repo-connected deployment. Cloudflare says Workers 'fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions', and a managed Workers Builds service exists, shown by its own MCP server and 'a Worker build completing' events. No item documents connecting a repository to trigger deploys, or automatic framework/build detection that removes manual build configuration. missing for 10: explicit docs on connecting a Git repo for automatic deploys, zero-config build/framework detection, hands-on or independent corroboration of the repo-connect flow
